adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts.present?` guard from `Topic#expandable_first_post?` (app/models/topic.rb), but does not replace it with an equivalent check against the new `EmbeddableHost` table (e.g., `EmbeddableHost.exists?`). Given the rest of the diff migrates "allowed host" logic from `SiteSetting.embeddable_hosts` to `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?` (EmbedController, TopicRetriever), leaving `expandable_first_post?` ungated can make embed-expansion behavior available even when there are zero allowed hosts configured (e.g., after deleting all `EmbeddableHost` records). The finding’s deeper call-chain to `open(url).read` isn’t directly verifiable from this diff, but the missing replacement gate itself is a concrete behavioral regression introduced here.
